case_title.quote: Karthi @ Karthick v. State Rep. by Inspector of Police, Tamil Nadu
case_title.reason: Matches the case caption in the judgment header.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant, Karthi @ Karthick, was convicted

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to with male pronouns, e.g. 'he', throughout.

accused_age.quote: The accused appellant was aged above 20 years at the time of occurrence.
accused_age.reason: Judgment says 'above 20'; the value 20 is not stated and conflicts with that wording.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.quote: belonged to the same caste as the prosecutrix
accused_caste.reason: Judgment states the accused belonged to the same caste as the prosecutrix.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not discussed in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is the prosecutrix, a female.

victim_age.quote: At the time of occurrence, she was aged between 18 to 20 years.
victim_age.reason: Judgment gives a range of 18 to 20; the single value 18 omits the upper bound.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not stated beyond sharing the accused's caste.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: besides being a neighbour of the prosecutrix
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment describes the accused as a neighbour of the prosecutrix.

offence_category.quote: Allegation of rape was made against the accused-appellant
offence_category.reason: Offence is rape, with deceit-based consent under s.417.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment cites Sections 376 and 417 of the IPC.

weapon.quote: after gagging her mouth with his right hand
weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned; only the accused's hand was used to gag.

evidence_type.correct_value: Victim's direct testimony; family and village elders' statements (circumstantial); friends' statements; medical examination referred to
evidence_type.quote: Dr. K.P.Santhakumari (PW14), i.e., the doctor who subjected the prosecutrix Poomari (PW1) to medical examination.
evidence_type.reason: No eyewitness to the act is described; evidence is mainly victim testimony, circumstantial witnesses and medical examination.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is described; he denied the allegations.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Aggravating circumstances are not discussed in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Mitigating circumstances are not discussed in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The trial court convicted the appellant under Sections 376 and 417 IPC.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss. 376 and 417 IPC, as stated.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Revision petition dismissed by the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court on 18.12.2006
high_court_outcome.quote: The appellant's Revision Petition (Criminal Revision Case No.439 of 2005) was dismissed by the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court on 18.12.2006.
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court did decide the revision and dismissed it; 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

offence_finally_established.quote: no doubt can be said to have been created in the version of the prosecution
offence_finally_established.reason: Court upheld the conviction, treating the sexual intercourse as non-consensual rape.

imprisonment_type.reason: Judgment mentions only serving the 'remaining part of the sentence'; no fixed term or type is given.

imprisonment_years.reason: No sentence length appears in the judgment.

neutral_facts.quote: The accused did not provide any evidence in his defense.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurately summarized without revealing the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state minimum or maximum statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: He then, had sexual intercourse with her.
attempt_completion.reason: Sexual intercourse actually occurred, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: No injuries are described; the judgment notes only that the delay prevented positive medical findings.

number_of_offences.quote: convicted for the offences under Sections 376 and 417
number_of_offences.reason: Two offences charged, convicted and affirmed on appeal and revision.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found the accused committed deceit by promising marriage; planning is not expressly found
premeditation_planning.quote: the accused-appellant Karthick committed deceit with the prosecutrix Poomari (PW1) by promising to marry her.
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found deceit, not planning; 'planned to deceive' overstates the finding.

motive.quote: Obtaining consent by exercising deceit, cannot be legitimate defence
motive.reason: Supported: the accused used a marriage promise to obtain sex, consistent with deceit.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: Three sets of statements, the first comprising of the prosecutrix (PW1), her brother (PW2) and her father (PW4)
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on PW1, PW2, PW4, village elders PWs5-8 and friends PWs9-10.

witness_credibility.quote: leave no room for any doubt
witness_credibility.reason: Court found the statements, read together, left no room for doubt.

post_offence_conduct.quote: The accused-appellant Karthick surrendered before the Judicial Magistrate No.II, Virudhunagar on 5.11.2003.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Surrender date and court are stated in the judgment.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated.

bail_history.quote: was ordered to be released on bail by this Court vide order dated 4.4.2008.
bail_history.reason: Bail order by Supreme Court dated 4.4.2008 is stated.

trial_duration.quote: The accused-appellant Karthick was ordered to be released on bail
trial_duration.reason: Stated dates and stages are supported; trial length itself is not given but nothing contradicts the value.

legal_representation.quote: R. Balasubrmanian, K.V. Vijayakumar, T.R.B. Siva Kumar for the Appellant.

investigation_status.quote: a charge-sheet was filed before the Judicial Magistrate No.II, Virudhunagar.
investigation_status.reason: Charge-sheet filing and committal to Srivilliputtur are stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.quote: The conviction was affirmed by the appellate Court and the Revisional Court.
appeal_history.reason: Appeal, revision and Supreme Court dismissal are accurately summarized.

prosecution_argument.quote: no doubt can be said to have been created in the version of the prosecution
prosecution_argument.reason: Reflects the prosecution's deceit and delay positions as accepted by the Court.

defence_argument.quote: the decision rendered in Uday vs. State of Karnataka
defence_argument.reason: Defence relied on Uday and argued consent was consensual and FIR delay mattered.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Obtaining consent by deceit is no legitimate defence; the burden-of-proof statement is a quote from Uday relied on by the defence
legal_principle_applied.quote: Obtaining consent by exercising deceit, cannot be legitimate defence to exculpate an accused.
legal_principle_applied.reason: Burden-of-proof language comes from the quoted Uday passage, not a principle the Court emphasized.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Uday v. State of Karnataka (2003) 4 SCC 46 and Zinder Ali Sheikh vs. State of West Bengal & Anr. (2009) 3 SCC 761 - referred to.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Both cases are listed as referred to in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Sentencing reasons not discussed; the Court upheld conviction because deceit vitiated consent
sentencing_rationale.quote: Therefore, in the facts and circumstances of this case, it cannot be said that sexual intercourse by the appellant with PW1 was consensual.
sentencing_rationale.reason: Reasoning concerns conviction and consent, not the sentence imposed.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment does not discuss mitigating factors, so 'None' is not supported.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment does not discuss aggravating factors, so 'None' is not supported.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Accused directed to be taken into custody to serve the remaining part of the sentence
other_sentence_order.quote: He shall now be taken into custody, to serve the remaining part of the sentence.
other_sentence_order.reason: The judgment contains a custody order, so 'None' omits it.
